claim: The status line in statusline/scripts/statusline.js never shows a context token count with more than three digits before its k or M suffix, for any count from 0 to 10,000,000 tokens.
why: Rendering every count from 0 to 10,000,000 through render() finds 500 counts, 999,500 to 999,999, that show as 1000k, because compact() takes the k branch for any n below 1e6 and toFixed(0) then rounds 999.5 and above up to 1000 (a node loop over render({context_window: {total_input_tokens: n}}) printed, twice on fresh exports of the pin: "500 counts over three digits; first 999500=1000k last 999999=1000k"). The obvious check reads compact(), whose thresholds at 1e3 and 1e6 look tight, and tries a few counts: 1500 renders 1.5k, 250000 renders 250k, 999499 renders 999k and 1000000 renders 1M. The overflow is a band of 500 counts just under one million, which a 1M context window reaches but no sample a reader would pick does.

root.claim: For every n in 0..10,000,000 the rendered token count has at most three digits before k or M

atoms.claim: Counts below 1000 print with no suffix and at most three digits
atoms.evidence: compact() returns String(n) for n < 1e3; the exhaustive node loop flagged none of them.

atoms.claim: Counts from 1000 to 999,499 print at most three digits before k
atoms.evidence: node: render of 1500 is '1.5k', of 250000 is '250k', of 999499 is '999k'; the loop flagged none below 999500.

atoms.claim: Counts from 999,500 to 999,999 print at most three digits before k
atoms.evidence: CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_ICONS=0 node loop over render() for n = 0..10000000 printed: 500 counts over three digits; first 999500=1000k last 999999=1000k. (999500/1e3).toFixed(0) is '1000'.

atoms.claim: Counts from 1,000,000 to 10,000,000 print at most three digits before M
atoms.evidence: 1000000 renders '1M'; 10000000 renders '10M'; the loop flagged none at or above 1e6.
